item.title: Ask about a coat repair
item.summary: A customer decides what can be repaired before a trip.
item.transcript_text:
Ivy: Can you mend this coat before Friday? One pocket has a hole and the zip is hard to close.
Tariq: The pocket is easy. I can finish that today. A new zip will take three working days because I have to order it.
Ivy: I leave on Thursday morning. Let's do just the pocket now.
Tariq: Fine. I'll write the size of the zip on your receipt, in case you want to come back later.

options: When to order a larger coat
questions.explanation: Ivy compares two repairs and chooses one.

questions.prompt: Which job can be finished today?
questions.explanation: Tariq offers to do the pocket immediately.
She says she leaves on Thursday morning.

questions.prompt: Why would the zip take longer?
questions.explanation: Tariq has to order the replacement.

questions.prompt: What will Tariq put on the receipt?
questions.explanation: The size will help if Ivy returns for the other repair.
